setup: Sit with the dumbbells on your thighs
Lie back, bringing them to your chest
Knees bent, feet flat on the floor
execution: Press both dumbbells to straight arms
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor
Press back up over your chest
faults: Don't crash your elbows into the floor
Don't let your wrists bend back

notes: No spotter is needed: the floor stops the weights. Still bring them to your chest and roll up to sit before putting them down.
Use a mat under the elbows and upper back.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

keyPositions.label: Bottom
keyPositions.describe: Upper arms resting on the floor about 45° from the body, elbows bent near 90°, forearms vertical. Dumbbells just above the chest.
